item.description: Silicon Valley spent big to kill California’s wealth tax — but incoming Democrats are eyeing a national fight.

item.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas next year to ramp Cybercab, Musk says
item.description: The Cybertruck and its polarizing design gained a niche following, but it did not achieve mass-market sales and Tesla has issued several voluntary recalls.

item.title: The wealthiest 10% of Americans are pulling ahead of everyone else. This is what’s making them richer.
item.description: The wealthiest 10% have a median net worth that is $800,000 greater than it was three years ago.
